items.title: Node.js Brings Debounce, Throttle, and PKCS#12 Parsing Into Core Modules

items.title: Open Source DocumentDB 1.0 Reaches General Availability
items.summaryShort: Open Source DocumentDB 1.0 Reaches General Availability. DocumentDB 1.0 is the first generally available release of the open source, MIT-licensed document database built on PostgreSQL, with compatibility for the MongoDB wire protocol.
